responses.reason: The ruling adopts the two-way proposal and balances macro-frame preservation against the 27:46 scene reset.

appeals.passage_context: Gen.26.34-Gen.28.9, especially the Gen.26.35/27.1 seam and wife-motif resumption at Gen.27.46
appeals.rationale: Gen.26.34-35 is a self-contained marriage notice with evaluative closure; Gen.27.1 resets time, participant, addressee, and objective. The two-way remedy attaches the notice to the intervening blessing conflict while separating it from the explicit wife-grief reprise and solution at 27.46-28.9.
appeals.requested_next_reviewer: fresh independent Hebrew narrative-discourse specialist or human adjudicator blind where feasible
appeals.proposed_disposition: Hebrew three-way; until resolved retain Gen.26.34-28.9 as a low-confidence deferred larger-unit hold
appeals.why_boss_counterevidence_is_insufficient: Avoiding a two-verse chunk is a granularity preference, not evidence that the notice lacks literary completeness; the macro-frame argument is weakened because the two-way split still detaches setup from explicit payoff.
